purpose: Test whether the existing complete SCAND behavior stream supplies enough route-general motion supervision to decode a four-step future path from real adapted-DINO latents, before any further LTWM training.
hypothesis: The failed 800-state inverse probe was sample-limited rather than representation-limited; route-excluded continuous SCAND windows will make the real t+4 latent action-observable across held routes.

full_stream_latents.frame_delta_scope: seven Jackal trajectories only; all local image/pose/yaw lengths were internally equal and the same 234 split-locked trajectory identities were retained

stream_windows.route_group: lowercase sorted pair of trajectory-id location tokens 4 and 5
stream_windows.route_exclusion: for each outer fold exclude every full-stream trajectory whose route_group appears in that fold, including all same-route bags and exact trajectories

inverse_probe.architecture: exact ActionObservableInverse from sparse probe; 145716 parameters
inverse_probe.target_standardization: mean/std from eligible full-stream windows after held-route exclusion

training.route_fold_assignment: exact deterministic assignment shared with the sparse probe
training.sampling: eligible full-stream route-uniform then window-uniform with replacement
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step; outer states and outcomes never select epoch or hyperparameters

fixed_primary_planner.definition: integrate inverse(real goal latent) into a four-step XY path and choose the physical/support union65 candidate with minimum mean squared XY path distance; formal-v70 remains in the set
fixed_primary_planner.outcome_independence: candidate score uses only predicted path and candidate actions
fixed_primary_planner.secondary_diagnostic: standardized 12D action-distance planner from sparse probe

branch_rule.if_observability_or_primary_performance_: Withdraw the sample-shortage hypothesis and stop the current adapted-DINO latent motion branch; do not tune the inverse architecture or return to ordinary selectors.
branch_rule.if_both_pass: Decode frozen warm-LTWM candidate futures with the same fold probes and evaluate the same path metric once.
branch_rule.if_warm_forward_passes: Freeze the existing latent metric and selector without LTWM retraining.
branch_rule.if_warm_forward_fails: Proceed once to frozen-probe path-cycle LTWM training without ATE/objective gradients.
